skyeGreeting: G'day, I'm the Chipper Chippy assistant. Got a repair, an install or a DIY project you need a hand with? Tell me about it and I'll help you get a quote or book a time with Becca.

about.headline: No job too big or too small. Done your way.
about.body: Most people want the same things from a tradie: someone who turns up, listens to what you actually want, and gives you a fair price before starting. Whether it's a list of jobs in a new house, a robe fit-out or advice so you can do it yourself, every job gets the same care.

realReviews.author: Rianna G
realReviews.text: Having just moved into a new house, we had an array of handyman/woman jobs we needed doing, and Becca was the perfect person to call on. No job is too big or too small for her, and her professionalism combined with her positive attitude makes hiring her a no-brainer. She replaced rusted locks, installed blinds that she custom-made, selected and installed handles on drawers and vanities, and perfectly wall-mounted our large tv. We couldn’t speak more highly of her or her service, thank you Becca!

realReviews.author: Harry Rand
realReviews.text: Our stairs were unstable and Becca did a great job of tightening the stringers. We asked her to come back and install grab rails in our bathroom and she is now our regular handy woman. Alex was easy to deal with and the price was very reasonable. Service with a cheeky smile!

realReviews.author: ria santos
realReviews.text: We had our walk‑in robe done and Becca was absolutely fantastic. She listened to what we wanted, offered practical suggestions, and the finished result is even better than we pictured. Friendly, reliable, and genuinely great at what she does. We’re so happy with the outcome and would definitely recommend her.

finalCta.headline: Got a job or a list that needs doing?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a clear price before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a friendly chat about the job.

faq.a: Send the job or your whole list through the form, or give Becca a ring. We'll ask a few questions, come and have a look if needed, and give you a transparent price.
Yes. Locks, handles, blinds and a TV on the wall are all part of the work. No job is too small.

faq.q: Can you help me do it myself?
faq.a: Yes. DIY advice and assistance is part of what we do, so you can tackle the project your way with a qualified carpenter in your corner.
Ballarat and surrounds, including Wendouree, Sebastopol, Delacombe, Mount Helen, Buninyong, Creswick and Learmonth. Close by but not on the list? Ask anyway.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to Becca, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to talk through the job and set a time.
